parsed.post: Discarding the recent run (1.029769) as it was a regression from my best (1.015525). Reverting to DEPTH 6, MATRIX_LR 0.05, WARMUP_RATIO 0.05. Next: I'll test increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.07 to see if we can push the peak further without destabilizing.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.07 to see if higher learning rate improves convergence with current depth and warmup settings.
